items.html: And then it is drawn from the Moach Stimaa of Arich Anpin, through the two Mazalot of the beard, to the Mochin of Aba and Ima, which clothe the Hassadim and Gevurot of Arich Anpin hidden within their Hochma and Bina; for the two upper segments, which are the aspect of the hands of Arich Anpin, are the aspect of the Hochma of Aba and the Hochma of Ima. And these two upper segments are called the inheritance [Achsanta] of his father and his mother, because these two segments reached their portion and their inheritance, and from there one drop is drawn from Aba and Ima, comprising two drops, and from them are made the two Mochin of Hochma and Bina in ZA.
